title: Incorporating Human Explanations for Robust Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through hate speech detection robustness and a novel Stereotype Intent Entailment (SIE) task using the Social Bias Frames dataset, which includes human-annotated stereotypes targeting women, coupled with saliency ablation tests (leave-one-out and adversarial adding attacks) to detect reliance on spurious word artifacts.

Evaluated through hate speech detection robustness and a novel Stereotype Intent Entailment (SIE) task using the Social Bias Frames dataset, which includes human-annotated stereotypes targeting Black individuals, paired with saliency-based single-word perturbation attacks.

Evaluated through hate speech detection robustness and a novel Stereotype Intent Entailment (SIE) task using the Social Bias Frames dataset, which includes human-annotated stereotypes targeting Jewish and Muslim individuals, measuring semantic alignment over spurious correlations.

Evaluated general discriminatory and targeted offensive speech (such as stereotypes targeting assault victims) by matching hate speech utterances with underlying human-annotated stereotype intent to measure semantic coherence versus artifact reliance.
